messages.content: Hi! Can you check the stock for the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones (p_sony_xm5_blk) and see if there are any coupons available for my account, user_123? I’d also like to get some collaborative recommendations for other electronics. Please pick the best alternative for a quantity of 1, add it to my cart, and provide a summary using the coupon SAVE15. From there, build an invoice and generate the final version to be paid via stripe for customer@example.com. Finally, could you fetch the latest business news and sort the headlines in ascending order for me?
